entries.subject: DAMIT 3934: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-3934.txt. Model 3934, version 2019-05-07, pole (172°, -5°), period 7.3063 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 131 ±8 km. occultation-constrained volume-equivalent diameter

entries.subject: NEOWISE thermal diameter 130.099 ± 0.554 km
entries.finding: [NEOWISE thermal diameter 130.099 ± 0.554 km](https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb.api?sstr=588&phys-par=1) — alternative — Consistent thermal effective diameter, but its formal precision omits systematic errors; occultation volume scale is more directly compatible.
entries.revisitWhen: New calibration or independent size evidence makes this alternative preferable to the currently adopted, physically compatible scale; do not average incompatible thermal fits.

entries.subject: Achilles whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 14 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.911 at 462 nm, 1.026 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#3c3a37 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4.3% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.6%), from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 759, 49; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
